annotations.text:
Seven screens, not twelve. The first canvas mapped the CLI verbs; this one maps the workflow.

The app opens on "Since main" — what changed, what broke, what the CI gate would say. Overview folded into it; Sprint and Hotspots became sort orders on Capabilities; Metrics split between Trust and capability detail.

Four verification states, one component set, used identically on capabilities, diagram nodes, requirements, scenario steps and repos:

VERIFIED — the claim holds, evidence attached.
DRIFTED — claim and code disagree. The only loud state.
UNVERIFIABLE — atlas cannot see enough to judge. Hatched, never green, never red.
NOT BUILT — declared, no implementation.

Making "unverifiable" first-class is the design consequence of #85: never paint a confident number over a blind spot.
The status bar carries the attribution figure on every screen. A coverage percentage means something different at 91% attribution than at 67%.

Four diagram kinds, drawn in real notation and shaded by evidence — the part the first canvas was missing.

SEQUENCE — lifelines, activation, returns. Message arrows carry state: solid green where a real call edge is covered, dashed red where the edge exists but nothing tests it, dashed grey where there is no evidence at all.
PROCESS FLOW — decision diamonds and terminators, from @atlas:saga / @atlas:consumer. The compensation branch nobody tests is visible as a red path.
DATA MODEL — entities with keys and types, crow's-foot relations, each table annotated with the sqlc queries that touch it and their coverage. An orphan table and a migration-only table read at a glance.
STATE MACHINE — authored, not generated: a status field and a switch statement do not announce themselves as a machine. Every drawn transition must map to a method, and every method that mutates status must appear in the drawing.

Authoring is where the binding becomes concrete: mermaid source on the left with anchors resolving inline (and a symbol picker that knows RetryQueue.Push was deleted in a41c9e2), the live preview shaded by the latest run on the right, and the findings that `atlas diagram verify` would report at the bottom. Save runs the check.
